heroSummary:
LAUSD begins the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The district calendar lists Friday, June 4, 2027, as the last day of instruction. Winter Recess runs December 21 through January 8, and Spring Recess is March 22–26.

This page covers LAUSD’s districtwide instructional calendar. School-specific events, early-dismissal days, and some charter or program calendars may differ.

whatsNew.title: What's Different in 2026–2027
content: School starts two days earlier: Wednesday, August 12 instead of August 14.
Spring Recess shifts from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 22–26 in 2026–27.
The district calendar’s listed last day moves from June 10 to June 4. Schools that use January 11 as a pupil-free day use June 7 as an instructional day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every LAUSD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers LAUSD’s districtwide instructional calendar. School events, early-dismissal days, affiliated charter calendars, and some program calendars may differ.

calendarFaqs.q: Are students off for the full week of Thanksgiving?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Students are off November 23–27, 2026. LAUSD designates November 23–25 as unassigned days and November 26–27 as the Thanksgiving Holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Are minimum days and early-dismissal days included?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Minimum days, early-dismissal days, conferences, and campus events are usually published by individual schools. Ask your school for its site calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all students return on January 11?
calendarFaqs.a: January 11 is the district calendar’s second-semester start date. LAUSD notes that a school may use January 11 as a pupil-free day; if it does, June 7 becomes an instructional day.
